endpoint_theorems.universal_negation: FlatBalance.not_flat_balanced_conjecture : not FlatBalancedConjecture, where FlatBalancedConjecture = forall (V : Type) (hV : Fintype V) (G : SimpleGraph V), Flat V hV G -> Balanced V hV G
endpoint_theorems.existential_counterexample: FlatBalance.flat_not_balanced_exists : exists V hV G, @Flat V hV G and not @Balanced V hV G, witnessed by V = Fin 3 (+) Fin 3, G = K33
